health.image_engine: ml-ai-image-classifier (v3 head; clean 79.5% acc / 74.1% balanced / 0.808 AUC)

parity_note: All three remote scores match the local end-to-end baselines exactly; the deployed runtime is identical to the verified local pipeline.
known_limitations: Scores are uncalibrated; visible in the UI as a heuristic score.
Image detector: ~79.5% accuracy on the fresh v3 test; weakest on LAION/Pexels mirror-real photos (~47%) - state this honestly in the viva.
Video detector: ~86.9% clean / 80.8% after H.264 stress; no face-swap domain in the video test set.
Railway free plan: app sleeps when idle; the first request after a nap takes ~30-60 s to wake.
